integrity: All displayed finite-sample identities were reconstructed from the published statistic. Computational checks are supplementary; the unbounded-tail and moment claims depend on the explicit regular-zero and submersion proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to scalar linear kernels under an independent Gaussian null. It proves a polynomial lower-tail bound and divergence for \(p\ge n-1\) but does not prove a matching tail asymptotic or finiteness below that threshold.
title: A finite-sample tail obstruction for Gaussian linear cross-HSIC
